scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ghec/contracts && npm run build -w @ghec/analysis && npm run build -w @ghec/github-client && npm run build -w @ghec/discovery && npm run build -w @ghec/migration
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w ghec-consultant-cli && npm run build -w @ghec/dashboard
scripts.typecheck:apps: npm run typecheck -w ghec-consultant-cli && npm run typecheck -w @ghec/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:apps
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=8 packages/contracts/tests/*.test.ts packages/analysis/tests/*.test.ts packages/github-client/tests/*.test.ts packages/discovery/tests/*.test.ts 'packages/migration/tests/**/*.test.ts' apps/dashboard/tests/*.test.ts apps/cli/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:unit
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:apps && npm run test:unit
scripts.validate:fixtures: npm run build -w @ghec/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/validate-fixtures.ts
